description: This file contains the Forgotten class, which is responsible for generating and dispatching password reset emails within the Opencart e-commerce system. It implements the index method to handle the email creation process when a user requests a password reset.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling password reset email generation and dispatch within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that verifies input, retrieves customer information, prepares email content, and queues a task to send the password reset email.
